response_text:
In Laval, Quebec during 2021–22, self-reported surveys found 28.9% of adults obese, 38.9% of youth overweight or obese, 16.5% with arthritis, and 8.7% with diabetes.

Note: the youth figure carries Statistics Canada's "E" flag — use with caution (95% CI 26.7–52.7%).
